Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I've been disappointed in the quality of most gas grills on the market so I decided rather than getting another grill that rusts out in year or two to pay the difference and get a quality grill.  The Weber Spirit II E310 grill is solid and well built.  It gets super hot quickly and maintains temperature during the cooking process.  I haven't added the igrill to it but will be soon to help monitor the meat without opening the grill to check it.  This is a great product and I'm looking forward to producing great meals for many years to come.  The only suggestion I would recommend is the hinging left side tray is not conducive to short moves.  If you lift it to pivot the grill it unhinges so you either have to push down on the right side or left the main body to move the grill on the two wheels.  It would be nice if you could "lock" the hinges(maybe you can and I don't know how) to be able to left the flat side and let the wheels pivot.  The reason I got it was to produce great steaks and wings and it does that better than any grill I've ever owned.
Results.Title: Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText: I just purchased my second weber spirit. My first was  a spirit and purchased 4 years ago, and great, a door to hide the tank and store utensils underneath. The price was between $300-$400. Our dealer is great, but they don't carry anything else. Fast forward to 2018 and the tornado blew away our grill. We replaced it with another weber spirit and are very unhappy. The wheels are sloppy when rolling and the pins kept falling out so I replaced with real clevis pins. The black covers keep falling off when i move it. If the grill is on the slightest uneven ground, the door comes off center and doesn't easily open. We spent the same amount of money and didn't get doors, just shelves, so I cant store anything on the grill without it being seen or stolen or getting dirty. The setup just doesn't look nice. Thank god for a cover to hide that. For another $100, I couldn't get the nicer style with a door unless I purchased another make. Quality seems to have gone downhill. The best features are the knobs in front, grates and burners going front to back, not sideways, and 2 trays on either side for placing dishes and food. If the shelves were blocked with a door I would store utensils underneath.
Results.Title: not impressed

So far it’s worked flawlessly. I only hope I can get 20+ years worth of all year round grilling like it’s predecessor!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
From the moment I opened the carton I was impressed with the quality and the thinking that went into our new Weber grill. Even the packaging was impressive. I've never seen such a clever and protective use of cardboard ... all kinds of cardboard. Assembly was made quite easy through the use of illustrations. Hefting each well-made and well-designed part only reinforced my perception that Weber is one company that genuinely believes in doing things the right way.

I've only grilled a few times in the month we've owned our Weber but each time I use it I get satisfaction in knowing we made a smart decision to purchase a Weber. I especially appreciated the Propane Tank gauge. A simple thing but incredibly helpful.

Like the additional features not offered on others, tank level indicator, double sided grates, heavy construction, easy to clean, replacable drip pans, large wheels for moving around the patio and yard.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I received my Spirit II E-310 for Fathers Day and have been using it consistently since.  I really like the simplicity of this design.  It provides me with exactly what I need, and does a great job cooking!  I've had gas grills in the past with numerous cooking features, side burners, ice buckets, bottle openers, etc.  It turns out these were things that I rarely used and they were the first items to fall apart.  

My one beef with this grill is the side tray often releases when wheeling the grill around my patio.
Results.Title: I like the simplicity of my Spirit II E-310.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
My purchase requirements:

1) Solid build (stainless steel shell, iron grates, etc.)

2) Warranty (wanted a company to stand behind its product)

3) Easy to use (quick to start, fast to heat to 500 degrees, easy to clean, etc.)

4) Good value (didn't need to be cheap, but my budget can't afford a $2,500 grill)

I did a few hours of Internet research to try and find the brand and model that met the 4 criteria.  I zeroed in on the Spirit II bc the feedback I read seemed to hit all of my requirements.  

I have been using it now for about 2 months...here is what I learned:

1) The build is rock solid.  I roll it in and out of the covered deck and does so with ease (not feeling like it is going to fall apart:)))).)

2) Can't say anything about the warranty other than what we all know...10 years.  I feel good that they will stand behind the product.  I called their customer service to ask if I could use a stainless steel brush on the iron grates.  The service rep was professional, timely and knowledgeable.

3) No kidding, it is up to 500 degrees in minutes w all three burners on.  Further, I use the brush on the grates each time and cleaning is easy.  We have taken the grates and bars off once for cleaning...all very easy.

4) So far, my feeling is that I paid a little premium for the Spirit (as compared to other brands), but the product is delivering.  That is all I can ask from a brand...deliver on your promises.

I cook for a family of 6...steaks, chicken, burgers, hot dogs, etc...it is big enough for us even with three teenage boys.  Happy grilling!!!!
Results.Title: One Heck of a Grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: It starts easily and cooks evenly.  Perfect for a newbie grill master like me.
